name: EX-02 Cyber Defence Sprint
description: Single-day cyber defence technical exercise (0800–1700). Blue team defends infrastructure against a simulated red team attack campaign. Covers detection, response, containment, and recovery. Ideal for IT security teams and cyber incident response training.

items.title: STARTEX
items.description: Exercise begins. Blue team takes defensive positions. All monitoring tools active. Red team isolated to simulation environment.

items.title: Security Baseline Assessment
items.description: Blue team documents current security posture: active services, open ports, patch levels, IDS/IPS baseline alerts.

items.title: Network Topology Briefing
items.description: Exercise director briefs all participants on the target network topology, known assets, and red team objectives.

items.title: INJECT: Red — Port Scan
items.description: Red team initiates reconnaissance via port scanning and service enumeration. Blue team should detect via IDS alerts.

items.title: Blue: Anomaly Detection Alert
items.description: Blue team triage the IDS alert. Confirm hostile reconnaissance in progress. Document and escalate to team lead.

items.title: INJECT: Red — Phishing Campaign
items.description: Red team launches targeted phishing campaign at three user accounts. Blue team should identify via email gateway logs.

items.title: Decision: Isolate Subnet
items.description: Blue team lead must decide: isolate the affected subnet to prevent lateral movement, accepting service disruption.

items.title: SITREP 1 — Blue Team Status
items.description: Blue team reports current threat status, actions taken, impacted systems, and recommended next steps.

items.title: Vulnerability Analysis
items.description: Blue team runs targeted vulnerability scans on affected systems to identify attack vectors being exploited.

items.title: Patch Deployment Sprint
items.description: Blue team deploys emergency patches to the three most critical vulnerabilities identified. Document each change.

items.title: INJECT: Red — Lateral Movement
items.description: Red team attempts lateral movement from compromised workstation to file server using credential harvesting.

items.title: Log Analysis — Forensics
items.description: Blue team performs live forensic log analysis to trace attack path, identify compromised accounts, and establish timeline.

items.title: SITREP 2 — Incident Status
items.description: Comprehensive incident report: compromise scope, affected assets, containment status, estimated recovery time.

items.title: INJECT: Red — Data Exfiltration Attempt
items.description: Red team attempts to exfiltrate simulated sensitive data via encrypted channel to external C2 server.

items.title: Decision: Network Segmentation
items.description: Decision to implement emergency network segmentation to prevent exfiltration. Accept partial service outage.

items.title: System Hardening
items.description: Blue team applies hardening measures: disable unused services, reset compromised credentials, update firewall rules.

items.title: Incident Report Compilation
items.description: Blue team compiles formal incident report documenting timeline, IOCs, attack vectors, and remediation steps taken.

items.title: Technical Debrief
items.description: Joint red/blue debrief. Red team reveals all attack steps taken. Blue team compares with detected activity. Gap analysis.

items.title: ENDEX
items.description: Exercise concluded. Systems restored. Lessons captured for follow-up training.
